messages:
ashwin: incident-bot page: private-cluster capacity alarm -> GPU queue > 90% for 8m (AcmeHealth-prod, eu-west-1) :rotating_light:
incident-bot: Trigger details: queue_length=127, throttled_requests=43, avg_latency=11.3s, autoscaler_state=ERROR
ashwin: I'm taking initial triage. digging into private cluster autoscaler logs now.
mikaela: oncall handoff in 10 — tag me if you need escalation to infra.
raul: heads-up from account team: AcmeHealth is on a Dedicated+Private contract, high-priority. cs is already watching.
ashwin: found repeated failures in node-bootstrap: ``Failed to attach GPU device: quotaExceeded`` across 3 AZs. looks like cloud provider returned 429-ish. logs: ```2026-05-03T02:14:21Z ERROR AttachGPU: quotaExceeded for project/zone gpu-nvidia-a100x  -> retrying```
ashwin: autoscaler shows backoff state and refused to create new nodes due to provisioner error; queue kept growing.
mikaela: can we hand this to sre-oncall? I need to start paging infra.
sre-oncall: I’m on it. joining now. Any immediate mitigation possible?
ashwin: we tried increasing maxNodes in the CRD but the controller failed with same attach error; patching doesn't help while cloud side is rate-limiting.
raul: acct-echo: Customer impact — several inference endpoints degraded, 503 spikes & 12s tail latencies, approx 27% of requests are throttled. They have a live cohort on Prod.
acct-echo: CS update posted to customer slack, awaiting their acknowledgement.
sre-oncall: propose temporary mitigation: 1) move a subset of traffic to hosted fallback model region eu-central-1, 2) reduce model size for some routes, 3) manual addon nodes in a different cloud project/quota if allowed. Which is feasible fastest?
ashwin: fastest is failover rule -> hosted fallback (we have policy for AcmeHealth to fail to hosted in emergencies). I can flip routing in ~5m.
mikaela: meanwhile I'll open a provider support ticket for quota and request expedited quota bump. copying logs.
sre-oncall: ashwin, when you flip routing please also enable traffic shard=10% first to monitor.
ashwin: doing canary now. command: ```./redwood route update --customer acmehealth --from private-eu-west1 --to hosted-eu-central --shard 10```
ashwin: command output: ```OK: routing update queued (change_id=chg-9921). propagation start 02:18:12Z```
ops-bot: deploybot: route-change chg-9921 started by ashwin — watch logs at https://console/redwood/routing/chg-9921
raul: CS asks for ETA to fully restore. if routing can move 100% in 15m that might be acceptable.
sre-oncall: we need to monitor token costs — hosted fallback will increase unit cost; inform finance/PM later. For now restore is priority.
mikaela: provider replied on ticket: "investigating internal quota throttling, ETA unknown". no immediate resolution.
ashwin: monitoring metrics: queue reduced from 127 -> 34 after 10% canary, avg latency down to 5.1s. Good signal.
sre-oncall: proceed with staged ramp: +30% -> +60% -> +100% every 5m if stable. I'll watch autoscaler and node events.
ashwin: ramp to 40% now. ```./redwood route set-shard chg-9921 --percent 40```
raul: CS relayed to customer: mitigation in progress, partial failover, team watching.
ashwin: finally at 100% at 02:25:46Z. queue drained to single digits, throttled_requests=0.
acct-echo: Customer acknowledged and appreciates quick mitigation, asked for postmortem and timeline.
mikaela: creating incident ticket and will coordinate postmortem with infra. can someone capture the exact bootstrap/gcloud errors?
sre-oncall: pulled provider logs and saved in /incident/2065432199/provider-logs.txt. main error: attachGPU rate limit + per-project per-minute attach cap hit.
ashwin: action items: - runbook update: add explicit fallback route test for Private failover (ashwin) - escalate quota policy with cloud provider (mikaela) - update autoscaler to surface attach quota errors to alerts (sre-oncall) - customer comms and SLA impact calc (raul)
ops-bot: incident created: INC-2065432199, severity=P1 (restricted), assignees: ashwin,mikaela,sre-oncall,raul
incident-bot: on-call handoff complete. Please add any additional telemetry you think is relevant. :white_check_mark:
mikaela: I'll follow up with CS to schedule postmortem in 24h and coordinate notes.
ashwin: leaving notes in thread and will mark resolved once provider confirms quota restored.
raul: thanks team. great quick coordination. :thumbsup:
